about: The city's own listing for the evening names a contest called There's Snow Place Like Plantation and says the winner is announced at the event, so families who entered will want to be there that night.

City Hall sits at 400 NW 73rd Ave in Plantation, and the Parks and Recreation line for questions is (954) 452-2510. The same Parks and Recreation office also runs Breakfast With Santa at Volunteer Park a week later.
faq: Is there ice skating at Light Up City Hall?
The City of Plantation's listing mentions ice skating along with snow, selfies with Santa, vocal groups, food trucks and crafts.
Who do I call about Light Up City Hall?
The city lists Parks and Recreation at (954) 452-2510 for more information.

about: Plantation Walk held the first Santa's Toy Drive Car and Truck Show in December 2025, and the 2026 show on December 13 is the return of that toy drive with the Plantation Police Department.
Plantation Walk says only tickets bought through Eventbrite are honored, and it lists cash donations under the ticket options for anyone who prefers to give money instead of toys.
faq: Do I need a ticket for the toy drive car show?
Admission is free, and Plantation Walk points to its Eventbrite page for tickets and cash donations. It says only Eventbrite tickets are honored.
Plantation Walk says the donated toys go to children at Joe DiMaggio Children's Hospital.
